source_policy: tracked schema only; runtime traces, screenshots, raw memory dumps, and original assets stay under ignored/private paths

process.wineprefix: Wine prefix used for Wine-internal helpers
process.win32_pid: optional Wine tasklist process id for win32-rpm
process.window_id: optional CGWindow id for correlation only

probe_targets.name: input_globals | menu_state | cursor_camera | selected_unit | selected_action | script_interpreter
probe_targets.source: static address, signature, symbol, hook, or scan rule

runtime_address_resolution.note: address ranges only; no process memory bytes are exported

read_attempts.name: input_current_bits
read_attempts.value_u32_hex: optional scalar value when status is ok

sampling.phase_hint: manual phase label only; not proof of game state
sampling.phase_profile: optional collector profile: title_idle | dialogue | player_control | action_menu | confirm_down | confirm_up | cancel_down | cancel_up | click_down | click_up | camera_scroll | script_phase

interaction_event.name: none | confirm_down | confirm_up | cancel_down | cancel_up | click_down | click_up | manual_phase_mark
interaction_event.source: operator label only; not proof of original semantics

sampling.run_id: optional string to correlate supervised traces from the same manual session
sampling.operator_note: optional short metadata-only note; no screenshots, paths, raw memory, or original text

read_u32.name: input_current_bits
read_u32.target_group: input | logical_cursor | menu | camera | script_phase | static_dispatch | custom

sampling.source_policy: read-only scalar sampling; no raw memory bytes are exported

samples.phase_hint: title | transition | opening_dialogue | player_control | target_select | turn_event | unknown
samples.interaction_event: none | confirm_down | confirm_up | cancel_down | cancel_up | click_down | click_up | manual_phase_mark

input.source_read: optional read_u32 name used to populate current_bits

first_probe_route: attach to the Wine process read-only
confirm executable hash and known static windows
sample input aggregator state before and after a supervised input
only then expand toward menu state, cursor/camera, selected unit, and selected action
forbidden_first_stage: raw memory dumps in tracked paths
claiming command semantics from capture alone
